about: Facts written in the project files, mapped to shop codes. dilute_10 / dilute_1 / dilute_01 = file 5 'บันไดเจือจาง' (ใช้ 10% / 1% / 0.1%): 1% and 0.1% are an odour-strength signal; all three set the dilution the step-by-step summary suggests (file 12 phase 3). blender = file 5 workflow step 5 'ตัวเชื่อม (Hedione, Iso E Super)'. signature = file 2 section 7 'ลายเซ็นแต่ละตัว'. Each list keeps the file reference so the app can show it.
